candidates.name: B-launch-only
candidates.rules: require estimated time-to-launch, not voyage/landing completion, before the recorded strategic window

candidates.name: C-launch-plus-embarkation
candidates.rules: require assembly, transport/escort delay, and embarkation (the recorded estimated launch time) before the recorded strategic window; voyage/landing excluded

candidates.name: D-hybrid-launch-then-revalidate
candidates.rules: same creation rule as launch-only; post-launch strategic-window revalidation is reported as observable/unobservable evidence only and is not simulated

candidates.name: D-M1-cap-sensitivity
candidates.rules: M1 with explicit risk sensitivity: either threatened cap 500, either critical cap 300

candidates.name: E-M2-cap-sensitivity
candidates.rules: M2 with explicit risk sensitivity: either threatened cap 500, either critical cap 300

experiment.capitalRiskNote: Caps are an explicit sensitivity set, not a proposed production rule.

currentLifecycle.creationFeasibility: assessLaunchFeasibility compares estimatedCompletionTicks (embarkation + voyage + landing; assembly/delay are currently zero at Fleet Ready) to the strategic opportunity window.
currentLifecycle.postCreationValidation: updateAmphibiousOperations validates war-ended, target/route/port validity, transport/escort/force loss, assembly timeout, and convoy integrity at ready/voyage/landing phases; it does not recalculate strategic opportunity-window feasibility.
currentLifecycle.abort: validation failures cancel the operation; land force is restored only if transport is in a controlled non-sea region, otherwise cargo is lost; transports/escorts/land units have movement reset and amphibious convoys are removed.
currentLifecycle.retarget: no operation retarget transition was found; target invalidation cancels the operation.
currentLifecycle.hybridLimitation: A counterfactually created operation cannot be physically simulated without changing the world. The report therefore records actual war survival to predicted checkpoints, but classifies strategic-state changes after launch as unobservable unless the operation was actually created.
